transcript.content: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Well, I came in because I'm having this issue with how I'm communicating with people lately. I work as a jeweler, and when a customer asks me a really simple question—like, just asking when a ring repair will be ready—my answer just goes completely off track. 

I'll start talking about the invoices, and then somehow I'm suddenly talking about garden soil, or... or my mortgage papers. I can actually see them losing me while I'm speaking, just looking at me confused. It's very frustrating and it's getting in the way of my work, so I thought I needed to come see someone about it.
Have you noticed any recent changes in your mood or energy level, like feeling unusually elated, irritable, or needing much less sleep than usual?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I definitely haven't felt elated or full of energy, and my sleep is pretty much the same as it always is. I'm not running on less sleep or feeling unusually irritable... just frustrated about the talking issue, really. But no, no big changes in my energy like you're describing.
Have you experienced any unusual beliefs that others don't share, or heard, seen, or sensed things that others couldn't perceive?

Well, I haven't heard or seen anything that isn't there, like voices or anything like that. But... I know it sounds odd, I really do. Lately, I've gotten convinced that some of the customers are coming into the shop just to check up on me—specifically to see if I'm going to miss my mortgage payments. 

They ask all these questions about the new showroom we put in, and it just feels like they're digging for information about my finances. My husband keeps telling me they're just being friendly and making conversation, but I just can't shake the feeling that they have an ulterior motive.
Do you have any medical conditions—like a head injury, seizures, thyroid problems, or other neurological issues—or do you use alcohol or any recreational drugs?

No, I don't have any medical conditions like that. No head injuries, seizures, or thyroid issues that I know of. And I don't drink alcohol or use any kind of recreational drugs, either. I just take a standard multivitamin, but that's about it.
How long have you been noticing these problems with your speech going off-track and these suspicious feelings about customers—has it been days, weeks, or longer?

Well, it's definitely been longer than just days or weeks. This whole change... it really started not long after we took on the business mortgage for the shop. So, it's been going on for almost two years now.

Aside from these speech and trust issues, have you noticed any changes in your motivation, interest in activities, or ability to show emotions—like feeling emotionally flat or withdrawing from friends and family?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean, I still care about the shop and my husband, and I still feel things normally, I think. I haven't been withdrawing from people or feeling flat... it's just the stress with the customers and the mortgage that's really getting to me. But my emotions and motivation seem pretty much the same as always.

latest_inference.note: The persistent disorganized/tangential speech (formal thought disorder) alongside a fixed, non-bizarre paranoid delusion for ~2 years, with preserved affect and motivation and no mood symptoms, favors schizophrenia. Delusional disorder (F22) is now less likely because prominent thought disorder (disorganized speech) is inconsistent with that diagnosis, which requires absence of such symptoms.
